sources.title: Hugging Face Microduck: $399 Open-Source Robot With Full RL Stack
sources.snippet: Hugging Face opened preorders this week for the Microduck — a $399 open-source biped robot built by Pollen Robotics, the French startup HF acquired in April 2025.

sources.title: Hugging Face Launches Microduck for Open-Source Robotics
sources.snippet: Hugging Face Launches Microduck for Open-Source Robotics Hugging Face is taking its open-source model philosophy into the physical world with Microduck, a $399 research robot built to let developers train and modify embodied AI systems. The company unveiled the duck-like machine on August 27, according to TechCrunch. An affordable platform for physical AI Microduck is a 25-centimeter-tall ...

sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.

sources.snippet: Hugging Face enters the physical AI market with Microduck, a $399 open-source robot designed for reinforcement learning and imitation learning. Learn how to integrate it with LLMs via n1n.ai.
